scope: Nineteen explicitly authored routes collected in Scotland and delivered within Britain. No reverse-origin pages or generated origin/destination combinations.

method.research: Official council, Scottish Government and transport-authority sources were searched and read on the review date. Retrieval status below distinguishes readable pages from indexed official extracts.
method.writing: Local regulatory facts are short paraphrases. Measurement, packing, inventory, contact and handover recommendations are original practical planning advice; they are not presented as the result of a property inspection or a completed job.
method.freshness: Readers are directed to current official guidance and the signs at their actual addresses. No permanent permit lead time, fee, traffic disruption or boundary-to-address decision is hardcoded.
method.transport: No road itinerary, mileage, journey duration, fixed arrival, vehicle availability, guaranteed permission or same-day delivery is asserted.
method.businessEvidence: No driver totals, allocated crews, depots, customer counts, reviews, work histories, prices or search volumes were invented or used.
method.implementation: The content is an explicit allowlist with full route-specific text. Destination coverage does not authorise collection outside Scotland. Booking and operational contracts remain outside this file.
